files_summary.users.json: Array of user profiles: id, email, name, timezone (IANA).
files_summary.holidays.json: Array of all-day US 2025 holidays: event_id, title, start_time/end_time (ISO-8601 UTC), attendees, location, type.
files_summary.events.json: Array of calendar events: event_id, title, start_time/end_time (ISO-8601 UTC), attendees (emails), location.
files_summary.README.md: Schema, lifecycles and business rules of this benchmark's datastore.

tool_schemas.name: list_all_users
tool_schemas.description: Lists users in the directory and returns a paginated collection of user objects. You may provide a positive limit and an opaque cursor to continue a previous listing. Requests are refused when limit is less than 1, when cursor is not a string, or when any fields other than limit and cursor are provided.

limit.description: Maximum number of users to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor to continue listing from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: get_user_by_email
tool_schemas.description: Looks up a single user by email address and returns that user object when found. The request must include an email string. Requests are refused when email is missing or not a string, or when no user exists with that email.

tool_schemas.name: list_all_events
tool_schemas.description: Lists calendar events and returns a paginated collection of event objects. You may provide a positive limit and an opaque cursor to continue a previous listing. Requests are refused when limit is less than 1, when cursor is not a string, or when any fields other than limit and cursor are provided.

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor to continue listing from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: list_events_in_range
tool_schemas.description: Returns calendar events whose start date falls within the inclusive range from start_date through end_date (YYYY-MM-DD). Both dates are required and the response is the set of matching event objects. Requests are refused when either date is missing, not a string, not in YYYY-MM-DD form, or when the range is invalid (for example end_date is earlier than start_date).

tool_schemas.name: get_event_by_id
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a single calendar event by event_id and returns the event object when found. The request must include an event_id string. Requests are refused when event_id is missing or not a string, or when no event exists with that id.

tool_schemas.name: list_user_events_on_date
tool_schemas.description: Returns the events attended by the specified user on the given date (YYYY-MM-DD). It returns the collection of matching event objects for that attendee and date. Requests are refused when user_email or date is missing, when either is not a string, when date is not in YYYY-MM-DD form, or when the user_email does not belong to a known user.

tool_schemas.name: search_events_by_title
tool_schemas.description: Searches event titles for a case-insensitive substring and returns the matching event objects. The request must include a query string to search for. Requests are refused when query is missing or not a string, or when query is empty or only whitespace.

query.description: Substring to search for in event titles.

tool_schemas.name: list_all_holidays
tool_schemas.description: Lists holidays and returns a paginated collection of holiday objects. You may provide a positive limit and an opaque cursor to continue a previous listing. Requests are refused when limit is less than 1, when cursor is not a string, or when any fields other than limit and cursor are provided.

limit.description: Maximum number of holidays to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor to continue listing from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: list_holidays_in_range
tool_schemas.description: Returns holidays whose start date falls within the inclusive range from start_date through end_date (YYYY-MM-DD). Both dates are required and the response is the set of matching holiday objects. Requests are refused when either date is missing, not a string, not in YYYY-MM-DD form, or when the range is invalid (for example end_date is earlier than start_date).

metadata.name: Keystone Calendar Directory
metadata.description: A lightweight calendar directory service that lets users look up people and query events and holidays by date range, attendee, or title.
